text: Slice 374 exit: Chromium measured two-/three-line wrapped layouts for the exact Woven finished-placket-width POM at live-draft:woven-shirt:14:14. Search covered 28 option rows with the unchanged source anchor/target/value/tolerance. The best three-line candidate has a 3.3135 cm leader and 0.2724 cm minimum clearance; rendered close-up confirms no text crossing. It is option-specific, so no stable mapping is proposed or implemented. A center-ending diagnostic route initially crossed its own text; corrected edge-termination was used for the final rerun. The bounded scan does not prove mathematical nonexistence. All 56 Woven and 34 Polo holds remain; 56 accepted / 90 held.
